name: Image-edit transfer suite (GEdit-Bench + ImgEdit-Bench)
description: Measures how much a small synthesised image-editing SFT set improves a frozen diffusion editing backbone. A method submits accepted (source, instruction, edited) pairs; the suite LoRA-trains a fixed backbone on them and scores the result on GEdit-Bench and ImgEdit-Bench under a VLM judge. The score attributable to the method is the delta over the untrained backbone under identical generation and judging settings. primary_score is the unweighted mean of the two benches after mapping GEdit-Bench from 0-10 and ImgEdit-Bench from 0-5 onto [0, 1].

dataset.notes: The suite evaluates two test sets, both registered under datasets/: gedit-bench and imgedit-bench. registry_id names gedit-bench as the primary reference because the schema carries one field.
